secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Free key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Enables the Gemini video engine. Without it, the local engine (frames + captions) works with no key.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Key from https://console.groq.com/keys. Enables Groq cloud transcription fallback.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Enables OpenAI cloud transcription fallback.
